_comment: This is a template for per-case metadata.json files. Copy and fill it out for each Brazil case.
title: Human-readable title of the case
event_type: sighting | encounter | landing | abduction | mass sighting | physical effects | other
summary: Short 1-3 sentence description of what happened

source.original_source: Brazil UFO Leaks | Personal archive | Military report | etc.
source.credibility_notes: Any notes on reliability, chain of custody, or concerns
source.registry_id: Optional link to the entry in data/metadata/sources.json

notes: Freeform notes, observations, context, or things to watch for during review
